title: Just Juice Bar Range Spearmint 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: The Just Juice Bar Range Spearmint Nic Salt e-liquid delivers a refreshingly clean and crisp mint flavour that’s both invigorating and smooth. With its subtle sweetness and icy coolness, this e-liquid is the ideal choice for vapers who enjoy simple yet satisfying menthol-inspired blends. Formulated with a balanced 60PG/40VG ratio, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid ensures a smooth and comfortable throat hit, along with rapid nicotine absorption. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod systems, Spearmint offers a satisfying and effective alternative to traditional tobacco products. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this e-liquid is a perfect all-day vape for menthol lovers. The Just Juice Bar Range brings the bold, concentrated flavours associated with disposable vapes into a more versatile and economical format for reusable vapes and vape starter kits . Alongside Spearmint, discover other popular flavours like Lychee & Mango, Blackcurrant Lemonade, and Sour Blue Razz Lime for a wide array of intense flavour options. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
